title: Mister Download Manager: free IDM alternative
caption:
Internet Download Manager charges $11.95/year to download files faster. Mister Download Manager does it for free ⚡

✅ Splits every download into parts and fetches them at once
✅ Resumes after a crash or dropped connection
✅ Grabs downloads from Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Brave
✅ Torrents, magnet links and one-click video downloads too

💻 Windows · Linux · Mac
ℹ️ It's a young project (4 weeks old): the Windows installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may say "protected your PC" (More info, then Run anyway). Mac builds are experimental, and you add its free browser extension to catch downloads. The "5x faster" claim is the developer's own local test, and IDM's $11.95 is a one-year license (lifetime is $24.95)

Comment "SPEED" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
